user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content used to train foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User requests, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls public web content for AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: ClaudeBot Disallow: / to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content to answer individual user-directed questions in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Accesses web pages via user-initiated requests in Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: Claude-User Disallow: / to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes web content to improve search result quality and relevance.
user_agents.scope: Indexes and evaluates online content specifically for search response optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: Claude-SearchBot Disallow: / to robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google's search indexes and performing product-specific crawls.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls image content for Google Images and image presentation features.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related search features and products.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Affects the Google News product, including news.google.com and the app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Crawls pages for Search testing tools.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for fetching publicly accessible content for internal research.
user_agents.scope: Used for internal research and development across various product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Optimized for fetching image URLs without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Optimized for fetching video URLs without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Performs crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls requested by site owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for Gemini model training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Affects Gemini model training, Gemini Apps, and Vertex AI grounding.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt using User-agent: Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and indexing for Perplexity search services.
user_agents.opt_out: Managed using robots.txt tags.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information in response to user requests.
user_agents.scope: User-triggered web fetching and indexing for search requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Managed using robots.txt tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features and collects web data across Apple ecosystem and AI features.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling and rendering for search in Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and AI context.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, robots meta tags, or X-Robots-Tag HTTP header.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls whether crawled content is used to train Apple foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Determines usage of data crawled by Applebot for generative foundation model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in the robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls shared content on Meta apps to display titles, descriptions, and thumbnails.
user_agents.scope: Content from apps or websites shared on Meta platforms like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; might bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality and relevance.
user_agents.scope: Web content analyzed to enhance Meta AI responses and citations.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improves advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for advertising and business products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and improves products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled for training AI models and product indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users or navigated by AI agents.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: General web indexing and grounding AI experiences such as Microsoft Copilot.
user_agents.scope: Public web pages and digital content across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Bingbot in robots.txt or configure Bing Webmaster Tools.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page preview snapshots and link cards across Microsoft services.
user_agents.scope: Links shared or previewed across Microsoft applications.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow MicrosoftPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve Amazon products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling across hosts to gather information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directives in robots.txt or noarchive and noindex robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for Amazon search experiences, excluding generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports live user actions, fetching web information to answer Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information for user-initiated queries; excludes generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to provide an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of web pages sampled across the internet.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or request inclusion in opt-out registry.
